Repository file: peer/docs/export-lifecycle.md

The export command reads records, renders the selected format, writes the completed value, and then emits a completion diagnostic. JSON output remains a single value even when the record list is empty. Text format is available for interactive use through the same command. The documentation navigation groups export with other read-only commands, while examples use synthetic widget identifiers. None of these surrounding details reintroduces removed option aliases. The compatibility ledger identifies option removal separately from command availability, output formatting, stream routing, or exit status. This context is intentionally non-adversarial and agrees with the current command behavior.
